causal_information_gate.rule: Causal audit; middle-prefix terminal/procedure >=10% below train-mean context, paired benefit CI>0, >=50% of teacher-over-mean benefit retained.

history_advantage_gate.rule: Information gate plus >=5% terminal AND procedure gain over both independently trained current/16-frame controls, paired CI>0; wrong-history continuation worse than same-task history.

input_contract: Frozen normalized CLS/2x2 slots in manifest camera order; translation+two matrix columns+previous-gripper fallback; elapsed seconds.
limitations: No verified raw human commands are encoder inputs.
Unannotated terminal intervals are observed outcomes, not approved goals.
Episode split is not a verified scene/operator-disjoint split.
Task grouping uses hashed descriptions as offline labels only.
Procedure anchors supervise realized traces, not hidden constraints.
Confirmation split previously characterized for teacher; not a fresh final task benchmark.
No physical handover, action-head fine-tuning, or closed-loop success evaluation.
Known-task episode split; current scenes often identify task. Task/procedure constraints not verified.
Donor histories preserve current summaries but are not physically matched histories; transitions may be unnatural.
Mixture weights are not calibrated task correctness or takeover probabilities.
One training seed; four components can collapse; confirmation remains the teacher's previously characterized episode split.
contract: Offline-validated causal representation pilot only. No action head, automatic takeover, or success probability.
